user:
Issue #542: AoT captures too many keys
Repository: python-poetry/tomlkit

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3

import tomlkit


doc = tomlkit.parse("a.b = 1\nc.d = 2\n")
aot = tomlkit.aot()
t = tomlkit.table()
t["x"] = 9
aot.append(t)
doc["a"] = aot
print(tomlkit.dumps(doc))
```
result
```
[[a]]
x = 9
c.d = 2
```
in which `c.d` has wrongly been captured by the array of tables.

Similar in flavour to other recent bug reports and fixes, I expect the fix will be nearby too.

The test file will be saved as tests/test_reprobot_tomlkit__542.py.
